blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte’s camp on Tuesday raised concerns over an alleged threat to the life of her former household staff, saying it may be part of another “relentless campaign” by the Marcos administration against her. Her legal counsel, Atty. Paolo Panelo, said Duterte received a message at 11:19 p.m. on Nov. 16 from her former household staff member, who asked for help and rescue in Manila. He said the unnamed staff member was in the custody of certain individuals who threatened their life and asked them to sign a document, which they refused to do. READ: Duterte: […]...
